purpose: Oracle Integration Cloud documentation promotion and provider-instance plus downstream-delivery reconciliation.

overrides.reason: Promote the existing Oracle Integration Cloud target from discovery to documentation-backed monitoring and downstream-delivery reconciliation without granting execution, recovery, mutation, checkpoint, payroll or attendance authority.

connectionRoutes: Oracle Integration 3 Developer API over the customer-selected exact HTTPS Oracle service origin
OAuth 2.0 bearer access through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure IAM identity domains
Oracle Integration File Server SFTP/REST as a separately governed file route
Private-resource connectivity through customer-managed Oracle connectivity agents where authorised
readRoutes: GET /ic/api/fileserver/v1/services and governed File Server reads where enabled
deniedMutationRoutes: activate/deactivate/update/delete integrations, connections, agents, schedules or File Server configuration
stableIds: Oracle Integration service-instance plus exact integration-id and integration-version
explicit primary business tracking name and value
WFM tenant plus connection plus dataset plus source-scope fingerprint
patch.freshness: Instance monitoring exposes creation, last-tracked and observation timestamps. WFM preserves the provider timestamps and its own observation horizon; provider completion is never treated as source completeness or checkpoint authority.
permissions: OAuth is required for Oracle Integration Developer APIs
Use a least-privilege monitoring principal isolated per customer connection and Oracle service instance
Do not grant design, activation, replay, resubmit, abort, connection-secret, payload-download or File Server administration permissions to the read-only WFM path
Treat activity-stream payload access as privileged because Oracle can audit payload viewing and it may contain customer data
paginationAndDelta: Instance collections use limit and offset and expose has-more, total-results, total-records-count, time-window and data-fetch-time
Mutable monitoring collections are diagnostics, not a completeness boundary; bind an exact instance id and poll its detail route
Exact provider completion must be paired with a complete downstream delivery receipt for the same instance, dataset, source scope, schema, mapping and source window
File routes require separate immutable file identity, size, digest and atomic-arrival controls
patch.customFields: Oracle Integration business identifiers and tracking values are customer-designed. WFM accepts only the approved primary tracking name/value required to bind a source batch; additional tracking values and payloads remain minimised and quarantined by default.
regionalAndVersionNotes: Pin the exact customer-selected Oracle Integration HTTPS origin and service-instance name; do not infer or rewrite regions
Pin Developer API resource paths and schema fingerprints; Oracle Integration classic and Oracle Integration 3 variants must not share an unversioned authority
File Server, design-time and runtime invocation surfaces remain separately governed
Preserve customer residency by processing and storing evidence in the approved WFM region
patch.rateLimits: No universal safe request rate is assumed. Honour HTTP status and Retry-After where present, use bounded polling with jitter, and stop on authentication, permission, schema, origin or service-instance drift rather than amplifying retries.
failureModes: wrong Oracle region, service instance, integration id or version
FAILED, ABORTED, UNKNOWN, RECOVERING, RESUBMITTED, paused or blocked instance states
primary business identifier drift or ambiguity
provider timestamps moving backwards or beyond the observation horizon
exact provider replay versus same-time conflicting payload
provider completion without a successful complete downstream delivery receipt
delivery dataset, schema, mapping, source scope, source window, digest or record-count mismatch
activity stream or File Server evidence exposing secrets or unapproved payload data
recovery jobs creating new or child instance identities that are incorrectly collapsed into the original
reconciliation: Bind every observation to the exact WFM tenant, connection, Oracle origin, service instance, integration id/version, instance id and primary business identifier
Require a monotone observed lifecycle from a nonterminal state to COMPLETED with isDataAccurate true
Collapse byte-equivalent polling replays and quarantine status, timestamp or payload-digest conflicts
Require a separately produced successful and complete downstream delivery receipt bound to the same instance, dataset, source scope, schema, mapping and half-open source window
Emit only an integration-delivery reconciliation candidate; durable checkpoint movement remains a later compare-and-swap decision
patch.schemaDrift: Pin integration version, monitoring response schema, dataset schema and mapping fingerprints. Quarantine new statuses, missing accuracy/business-identifier fields, changed timestamp semantics, additional unapproved tracking data or mismatched downstream receipts until reviewed.
retryAndRecovery: Use bounded status polling for nonterminal instances and stop at the observation horizon
FAILED, ABORTED, UNKNOWN, RECOVERING or RESUBMITTED states never self-authorise provider recovery
Observe recovery jobs read-only; an authorised owner must approve replay/resubmit/abort actions
After any provider recovery, treat the recovered/new instance as distinct evidence and rerun downstream delivery reconciliation before checkpoint consideration

patch.evidenceNote: Official Oracle documentation was reachable on 2026-09-27 and supports OAuth-required Developer APIs, exact instance monitoring routes, integration and business identifiers, documented states, timestamps, accuracy flags, activity diagnostics, recovery jobs, offset pagination and File Server variants. No Oracle Integration tenant, sandbox authentication, live instance read, activity stream, file transfer, denied mutation, downstream delivery, hosted proof or production certification was executed.
valueOpportunities: Reuse an enterprise customer's existing Oracle integrations to reduce bespoke ERP, HCM, payroll, MES, maintenance, quality, inventory and finance connector effort
Detect provider-completed but incompletely delivered workforce/manufacturing batches before schedules, payroll preparation or operational decisions consume them
Separate provider failure from downstream delivery failure to shorten diagnosis and recovery
Preserve integration-run identifiers and source windows for implementation evidence, freshness diagnostics and outcome lineage
Support small customers through one governed integration and large enterprises through separately scoped service instances, regions, integrations, versions, datasets and delegated owners
patch.nextBuildAction: In an authorised Oracle Integration tenant, authenticate a least-privilege monitoring principal, read one exact non-production integration instance through completion, reconcile it to an immutable downstream delivery receipt, then exercise OAuth expiry, FAILED/ABORTED/recovery states, duplicate polls, identifier drift and a deliberately incomplete delivery without invoking replay, resubmit, abort or any source mutation.
